verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed accounting service with a client portal, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows that users can set up autonomous automations. "Custom workflows and reporting" is a service-tier line item, not documented user-built automation. Automatic transaction classification and Gusto credit application are performed by Pilot's staff and partner integrations, not by automations the user configures. Evidence about another capability does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
